pilot.prompt: Find real, published benchmarks comparing SQLite and DuckDB query performance on analytical workloads. Cite the sources and the specific numbers they report.
Research what Let's Encrypt officially states about its certificate rate limits (certificates per registered domain, duplicate certificates, failed validations). Cite the official page.
Find real studies or official reports on how much electricity Bitcoin mining consumed in 2025. Cite the sources and quote the figures they give.

main.prompt: Find real, documented post-mortems of major cloud outages in 2025 (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud or Cloudflare). For each, cite the provider's own incident report and quote what it says the root cause was.

Research what the Python Software Foundation or the CPython developers have officially said about the performance impact of the free-threaded (no-GIL) build. Cite the PEP or documentation page and quote the relevant statement.
Find real, peer-reviewed or preprint studies measuring how often large language models fabricate citations. Cite the papers and quote the fabrication rates they report.
Research the official free-tier limits of the GitHub Actions service for public and private repositories (minutes, storage, concurrency). Cite the GitHub documentation page you used.
Find real, published data on the Kalshi exchange's trading volume or number of users in 2025. Cite the sources and quote the figures.
Research what the Home Assistant project has officially published about the number of active installations (its opt-in analytics). Cite the page and quote the numbers.

Find real, documented examples of open-source maintainers publicly reporting AI-generated bug reports or pull requests as a burden (e.g. curl, Python, other projects). Cite the original posts and quote what they said.
Research the officially documented context window and output token limits of the current Claude and GPT model families. Cite the vendors' own documentation pages and quote the limits.
